description: Observation Ledger architecture debt ratchet. Exceptions are exact, fingerprinted, owned, and expire in named PR phases. Reductions are allowed; new or increased debt is rejected.

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May record a legacy session-boundary bead using explicit session lifecycle input.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not infer user meaning, claims, goals, or relationships.
exceptions.justification: Legacy callers require a session boundary until SourceEvent capture replaces this writer.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: session_id and continuity snapshot

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May record a legacy flush checkpoint from explicit process state.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not infer semantic completion or manufacture observation meaning.
exceptions.justification: Flush checkpoint beads remain a compatibility authority until the observation pipeline cutover.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: flush transaction id

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May preserve caller-owned external evidence and source coordinates.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not convert source evidence into unsupported semantic truth.
exceptions.justification: External evidence currently enters through the legacy bead boundary.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: source id, source event id, and hydration ref

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May append operational pending, retry, and repair status.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not represent an operational state as a canonical semantic bead.
exceptions.justification: Legacy semantic status remains outside the target job and receipt ledger.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: session id, turn id, and status history

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May project explicit persisted associations and structural links.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not infer predicate, direction, time, causality, or truth.
exceptions.justification: The legacy graph projection predates the unified projection registry.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: association or link source field

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May rebuild edges from explicit persisted structural fields.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not invent or upgrade semantic relationships.
exceptions.justification: The legacy graph backfill remains until SQL-ledger projection cutover.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: explicit link or association id

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May emit explicitly marked legacy shadow recommendations.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not make canonical promotion or truth decisions.
exceptions.justification: Legacy heuristic promotion remains visible debt until ContextViewRevision replaces it.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: heuristic version and visible bead id

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May score legacy promotion candidates as noncanonical advice.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not persist canonical promotion state or alter factual authority.
exceptions.justification: Legacy candidate scoring remains until LLM-authored context assembly is live.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: score, threshold, and candidate bead id

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May emit explicitly marked legacy demotion recommendations.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not mutate archive retention or canonical truth.
exceptions.justification: Legacy rebalance remains until the unified hot-context projection is live.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: score, threshold, and candidate bead id

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May emit legacy advisory claim candidates with extractor provenance.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not establish a canonical claim or current truth.
exceptions.justification: Legacy heuristic extraction remains until annotate_event and revise_assertion replace it.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: extractor mode and turn id

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May emit legacy claim-update advice for explicit review.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not resolve, supersede, or retract canonical claims automatically.
exceptions.justification: Legacy update policy remains until the single revision resolver is authoritative.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: trigger bead id and authored review provenance

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May apply an explicit agent decision to a scoped legacy candidate.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not auto-resolve claims or endorse artifacts without an attributed decision.
exceptions.justification: Dreamer candidate state remains a separate lifecycle until Artifact migration.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: candidate id, explicit_agent_action, and scoped-resolution receipt

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May emit relationship-neutral legacy causal candidates.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not persist causal truth or structural edges from lexical overlap.
exceptions.justification: Legacy causal backfill remains until governed association review replaces it.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: candidate overlap and source and target ids

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May shortlist relationship-neutral bead pairs from mechanical signals.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not select a predicate, direction, time interval, or causal status.
exceptions.justification: Legacy association coverage remains until neutral collectors move to the ledger.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: pair bead ids, signal kinds, and candidate generation version

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May expose the legacy fallback flag for compatibility and visible diagnostics.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not silently enable deterministic semantic authorship.
exceptions.justification: The invariant-changing legacy flag remains until typed configuration cleanup.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: explicit configuration source and fallback telemetry

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May produce explicitly identified compatibility output while the legacy writer exists.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not be treated as a valid Observation Ledger annotation or quality success.
exceptions.justification: Legacy bead-field fallback is removed by the no-fallback semantic runtime closure.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: fallback marker, source event, and failure receipt

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May delegate an explicit structural projection write to the legacy graph implementation.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not infer relationship meaning or accept an unprovenanced edge.
exceptions.justification: The legacy structural facade remains until graph projection registry cutover.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: explicit canonical association or structural source field

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May apply an explicit caller-requested legacy goal lifecycle transition.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not infer goal adoption, completion, abandonment, or decay.
exceptions.justification: Legacy goal lifecycle remains separate until unified Artifact migration.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: authenticated caller action and goal evidence

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May persist a validated, attributed association judge decision.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not replace a missing or invalid judge result with relationship meaning.
exceptions.justification: Legacy association application remains until ledger-backed association review.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: judge attempt receipt, evidence refs, and validated decision

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May apply validated, attributed association proposals through the legacy store.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not infer or repair predicate, direction, time, or causality deterministically.
exceptions.justification: Legacy proposal application remains until the canonical association append path.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: proposal receipt, evidence refs, and explicit apply request

exceptions.allowed_behavior: May invoke the legacy candidate and governed association pass.
exceptions.forbidden_behavior: Must not convert deterministic overlap into canonical relationship truth.
exceptions.justification: Legacy association pass remains until neutral collectors and LLM review replace it.
exceptions.provenance_requirement: run id, candidate provenance, and judge receipt

invariants.CM-ARTIFACT-001: Derived artifacts share one evidence-bound append-only lifecycle.
invariants.CM-ASSOC-001: Association predicate, direction, time, and causality are evidence-bound LLM decisions.
invariants.CM-BENCH-001: Benchmark shortcuts and gold leakage disqualify quality evidence.
invariants.CM-BOUNDARY-001: Integrations translate observations and never invent semantic authority.
invariants.CM-CLAIM-001: Current truth follows explicit revision chains; unresolved conflict is ambiguous.
invariants.CM-LEDGER-001: Canonical semantic state is append-only and has one authority.
invariants.CM-OBS-001: Every bead is an evidence-bound annotation of an observed event.
invariants.CM-PROMOTION-001: Promotion affects hot context only and cannot upgrade truth or delete archive evidence.
invariants.CM-RETRIEVAL-001: Retrieval uses one evidence-hydrating pipeline and cites or abstains.
invariants.CM-SEM-001: Meaning-bearing fields and conditional decisions are LLM-authored.
invariants.CM-SEM-002: Semantic failure writes no manufactured fallback meaning.
